metadata.question: On July 7, was the year-to-date rainfall in the coastal city of La Serena lower than the 1990-2020 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: CHIRPS Daily (= `UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY`), precipitation in mm. - Location: La Serena, Chile (-29.9, -71.25) – coastal city. - Date windows • 2023: 1 Jan – 7 Jul (the July-7 date of interest) • Climate normal: 1 Jan – 7 Jul for every year 1990-2020 (31 years). 2. Masking strategy – None needed, CHIRPS is gap-filled; just sum valid pixels. 3. Distinguish Valid-Zero from Null/Error – If either collection is size=0 → C1. – After summing, check pixel count: if 0 valid pixels → C2. – If sum result is None/NaN → C3. – Otherwise compare 2023 sum vs 1990-2020 mean sum → A (lower) / B (not lower). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.25, -29.9]) # La Serena scale = 5000 # CHIRPS native ~5 km # --- 2023 YTD rainfall (1 Jan – 7 Jul) ------------------------------------ col23 = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-07-08')) if col23.size().getInfo() == 0: print("2023: C1"); print("C1") sum23 = (col23.sum() .multiply(0.1) # CHIRPS units 0.1 mm → mm .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=pt, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) .get('precipitation').getInfo()) # --- 1990-2020 climate normal (same period) ------------------------------- colClim = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1990,2020,'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1,188,'day_of_year'))) # 1 Jan–7 Jul if colClim.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Climate: C1"); print("C1") meanClim = (colClim.sum() .multiply(0.1) .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) .get('precipitation').getInfo()) # validation if sum23 is None or meanClim is None: print("C3") else: print(f"2023 YTD: {sum23:.1f} mm | 1990-2020 mean YTD: {meanClim:.1f} mm") print("A" if sum23 < meanClim else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.25, -29.9])          # La Serena
scale = 5000                                     # CHIRPS native ~5 km

# --- 2023 YTD rainfall (1 Jan – 7 Jul) ------------------------------------
col23 = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
           .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-07-08'))
if col23.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("2023: C1"); print("<answer>C1</answer>")

sum23 = (col23.sum()
            .multiply(0.1)                       # CHIRPS units 0.1 mm → mm
            .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                         geometry=pt,
                         scale=scale,
                         maxPixels=1e9)
            .get('precipitation').getInfo())

# --- 1990-2020 climate normal (same period) -------------------------------
colClim = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1990,2020,'year'))
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1,188,'day_of_year')))  # 1 Jan–7 Jul
if colClim.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Climate: C1"); print("<answer>C1</answer>")

meanClim = (colClim.sum()
               .multiply(0.1)
               .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=pt,
                             scale=scale,
                             maxPixels=1e9)
               .get('precipitation').getInfo())

# validation
if sum23 is None or meanClim is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2023 YTD: {sum23:.1f} mm | 1990-2020 mean YTD: {meanClim:.1f} mm")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if sum23 < meanClim else "<answer>B</answer>")
